description: Objective evaluations (centipawns, White's point of view) per half-move, from a full-strength Stockfish depth-12 analysis of each position in the 4-game ladder. Positive = good for Claude (White). The 'blunder_ply' is the half-move after which the eval fell off a cliff.

1350.blunder: 16.Nc7+?? Bxc7 (unsound fork; d8-bishop defended the square)

1800.blunder: 18.Bf3?? exf3 (hung the bishop to the e4-pawn)

2200.blunder: 21.Rxb6?? (traded off the defensive rook; unleashed Black's attack)

2600.blunder: 12.c3?? c5 (defended a pinned knight with a pawn; ...c5 won it)
